phase: Phase F2 - first orbit determination of LRO from real tracking: 12 h arc, range only, compared with the LOLA precision orbit
written: 2026-10-24, before any F2 number was computed
data: F1's 2009-260 arc: 2 473 USN S-band two-way ranges (PAD 103, 105, 126), 6 passes over 12 h (2009-09-16 23:57 to 2009-09-17 12:00 UTC)
measurement_model: F1's M_FULL unchanged (DSN_C2 light time, DE440, high-precision Earth PCK, solid tide, Niell troposphere, S-band climatological ionosphere)

dynamics.gravity: GL1800F (gravity_data_root()/gl1800f/jggrx_1800f_sha.tab) truncated at degree/order N, its own GM and radius, MOON_PA_DE440 in direct-epoch mode (harmonic_epoch_et0), the matched analytic Pines gradient in the STM (harmonic_stm_opt_in); N in {60, 100} (100 is the qualified upper limit of the harmonic STM path)
dynamics.third_body: Earth and Sun point masses, DE440, through sample_moon_centered_ephemeris on a 60 s grid; GM from gm_de431
dynamics.srp: cannonball, CONICAL_PENUMBRA lunar shadow, K_SRP estimated from K0 = 0.01 m^2/kg (no prior)
dynamics.propagation: dynamics.PropagationProfile() (DOP853, shadow events), rtol 1e-10, atol 1e-11 (relaxed from 1e-11 / 1e-12 for runtime; D1 measured DOP853 at 1e-11 at 0.2 mm/day, so this is still far below the metre-level question)

estimation.solve_for: initial state at the arc epoch (first range - 120 s) in Moon-centred J2000, K_SRP, one constant range bias per station (3)
estimation.algorithm: Gauss-Newton with Levenberg-Marquardt damping (in the F2 script; the production two-way estimators are built around the synthetic PassGeometry pipeline), unit weights at sigma 1 m, partials from propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity through relativistic_light_time.two_way_range_partial, bias partial 1
estimation.a_priori: the LOLA SPK state at the epoch plus a deterministic offset of 1 km in each position axis and 1 m/s in each velocity axis (so the result is not seeded with the reference); a second start with the opposite sign checks independence
estimation.termination: relative cost change < 1e-8 with a position step < 1 mm, or 30 iterations

gates.G1_convergence: both starts converge per the termination rule for N = 100
gates.G2_start_independence: the two starts agree to <= 1 cm in position over the arc and <= 1 mm in each bias (N = 100)
gates.G3_postfit: post-fit range RMS <= 2 m over all passes (N = 100)
gates.G4_partials: the analytic range partials agree with central finite differences of the full model (state steps 1 m / 1 mm/s, K step 1e-3) to <= 1e-4 relative on 10 sampled ranges (N = 60)

reported_not_gated.comparison: position difference to the LOLA SPK over the arc: RMS and max of the radial / along-track / cross-track components and of the total, for N = 60 and 100
reported_not_gated.biases: estimated station biases vs F1's per-pass means (Dongara 487.8-490.8 m, South Point 476.9 m, Kiruna 474.5 m)
reported_not_gated.K_SRP: the estimate and its formal sigma
reported_not_gated.expectation: the difference to the LOLA orbit is dominated by gravity truncation at N <= 100 for LRO's ~50 km altitude (LOLA used GRGM900C to degree 600) and is expected to shrink from N = 60 to 100; F1b puts the reference's own along-track error at ~5-7 m

not_in_scope: Doppler, multi-day arcs, momentum-dump modelling, box-wing SRP, degree > 100, empirical accelerations
